title: 2D / grid DP
learn: dp[i][j] on grids and two strings
hook: Unique Paths, Minimum Path Sum, Longest Common Subsequence and Edit Distance are the classic 2D DP problems. Edit Distance in particular is a favourite at companies that care about fundamentals.

explain.prompt: Explain the DP for Longest Common Subsequence: what dp[i][j] means, the recurrence, and the complexity.
keyPoints: dp[i][j] = LCS length of the first i characters of a and the first j characters of b
if a[i−1] == b[j−1]: dp[i][j] = dp[i−1][j−1] + 1 (extend the diagonal)
otherwise dp[i][j] = max(dp[i−1][j], dp[i][j−1]) (drop a character from one string)
row and column 0 represent empty strings and are 0
O(m·n) time, O(min(m, n)) space with rolling rows
